title: Patch: Evaluate Only Data
story: eval runs anything. ast.literal_eval only understands plain Python data.
goal: Write parse(text) that returns the Python value for data like [1, 2] and raises ValueError for anything else.
hints: ast.literal_eval is the safe cousin of eval.
Catch its errors and raise ValueError yourself.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
